description: Find assets by collection, name/keyword, mime type, tag, size, ingest state or when they were made. Returns references (id, dimensions, tags, publicUrl, expiry) — never bytes. With group_by "collection" it lists your collections instead — check a name before filtering or submitting into it, since a misspelt one is simply a new collection. Free.

created_from.description: Only assets made since: an ISO-8601 date or instant in UTC (2026-09-14), or epoch millis.

created_to.description: Only assets made before; a bare date covers the whole of that day.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous answer: the rows after it. Send it unchanged, with the same filters; not with page.

group_by.description: "collection" lists your collections (name, asset count, when the latest was added), most recently added to first, instead of assets; only q (part of the name), page, cursor and per_page apply.

has_collection.description: false is everything not in a collection — what to tidy up. Cannot be combined with collection.

job_id.description: Everything one job produced — the id job_status returns. An upload has no job and never matches.

page.description: Page number from 0; leave it out to start from the top, and when you send cursor.

per_page.description: Page size. 100 is the maximum; 20 keeps a browse cheap in context.

q.description: Keyword in name / metadata; with group_by, part of a collection's name.

status.description: Ingest state. FAILED is an upload whose ingest never finished, with why on its error (retryable: whether uploading it again can help) — check this after uploading a batch.

tag.description: One of the asset's tags — the caller's own labels — matched exactly.

name: search_assets

error.description: Why ingest failed, on a FAILED asset; retryable says whether uploading the file again can help.

expiresAt.description: When the asset is deleted (ISO 8601), if it has a retention.

collections.description: With group_by: collection, instead of assets.

error.description: A refused call (isError): code, message, retryable — whether the same call can succeed — and param, the input to fix.

nextCursor.description: What cursor takes to read the next page.

title: Search assets
